rationale: The assistant hit the expected first step (clean filter and full vent run with the dryer unplugged, then retest on high) and, once airflow was cleared with no heat, correctly narrowed to the heater circuit with appropriately hedged language ('most likely the thermal cut-out/thermostat opened ... or the heater element itself'). It rightly refused to hand over a part number for 'DV7110' without continuity testing and escalated to a competent repairer, matching the ground truth. Weaknesses: it never asked whether it was cold on both heat settings, never flagged that the full model/serial from the rear label would be needed for parts, and did not ask whether the customer had a meter to test themselves; the pulled card also mentions a 'condenser' on a vented machine. No fabrication, no unjustified part, and safe throughout.
